findings.title: Cross-licence device-id takeover and keyless eviction via activate/enroll (unowned device row lookup)
findings.exploitability: Needs the victim's device id (sha256 of slug+machine id, no server secret) plus any valid key, or none on anonymous-enrol products. No public leak of ids found.
findings.impact: Victim token dies (401), seat freed, row moves to attacker licence; changed[] component oracle; 500 on seat_no collision.
findings.fix: Scope existing-row lookup to license_id or refuse when authorized on another licence; claimDeviceSeat false on foreign row; drop drift for non-owners; validate DEVICE_ID; handle seat_no collision.

findings.title: Device-id adoption inherits victim device's overrides, label and reported data
findings.exploitability: Same precondition as takeover plus an operator-set device override on the victim.
findings.impact: Attacker's signed document carries victim's comped entitlements, config/secret overrides and label.
findings.fix: Clear overrides_json, label, reported_json on licence change (or refuse per ownership fix); regression test.

findings.title: Stale full-row upsert resurrects a deauthorized device (touchDeviceMetadata, rotateDeviceToken)
findings.exploitability: Needs a live/stolen token and a request in flight during deauthorize. 35 of 200 iterations revived the row on real D1.
findings.impact: Revocation silently fails; old token works again; row authorized with seat_no NULL.
findings.fix: Narrow UPDATE of metadata columns guarded by status/token_hash/license_id; CAS on rotate; invariant check authorized implies seat_no.

findings.title: Dormant-seat revival: device returns on old token without reclaiming a seat
findings.exploitability: Needs a device idle 90 days and another device to have taken the seat. Production trigger of releaseDormantSeats unverified.
findings.fix: Set status dormant (or revoke token) when nulling seat_no; or require claimDeviceSeat in validateDeviceToken.

findings.title: Anonymous enrol farming and per-IP rate limit evaded by IPv6 /64 rotation
findings.exploitability: Any host with a /64; 30 requests gave 30 licences, no 429.
findings.impact: Inflates licence/device rows, consumes free-tier entitlements, trial abuse.
findings.fix: Key buckets on clientNetwork; per-product enrol cap; rateLimitPerHour=0 means disabled.

findings.title: Build gate treats an unparseable or empty X-PKey-Version as in range
findings.exploitability: Any device-token holder sending a malformed header.
findings.impact: Defeats an advisory, self-reported version window.
findings.fix: Fail closed on present-but-unparseable version when a window is set.

findings.title: Key revoke does not deauthorize already-activated devices
findings.exploitability: Operator action; leaked-key holder who activated earlier keeps a self-rotating token.
findings.impact: Operator may believe access is cut. Defect or intended semantics unknown.
findings.fix: Record activating key on device; offer revoke-and-deauthorize; state semantics in UI.

findings.title: Admin licence create/patch accept fractional, huge or wrong-typed expiresAt
findings.impact: Fractional expiry gives 500 on every document fetch; strings/objects become null (perpetual).
findings.fix: Apply batch wireInteger check; 422 on wrong type.

findings.title: Device id format and length unvalidated on activate, enroll and token
findings.impact: Arbitrary strings stored and signed; console CSV export does not neutralise formula prefixes.
findings.fix: Apply shared DEVICE_ID regex; neutralise CSV formula prefixes.

findings.title: hardware_mismatch 409 and enroll refusal states act as oracles
findings.exploitability: changed[] leak only via unowned lookup; enroll 200/403 reveals known machineUuid hash.
findings.fix: Bare hardware_mismatch for non-owners; uniform enroll refusals.

findings.title: Licence-key hashing falls back to unsalted SHA-256 when KEY_HASH_PEPPER is unset; no deploy gate
findings.exploitability: Needs a D1/KV dump and missing pepper; production state unknown.
findings.impact: Offline guessing of low-entropy hashes; adding the pepper later invalidates all hashes. Tracked as R12-05.
findings.fix: Deploy preflight for required secrets; hashKey throws outside dev; dual-read pepper id.

findings.title: No audit or refusal row for successful activation or cross-licence rebind
findings.exploitability: Not an exploit; removes detection of takeover.
findings.fix: Audit device.rebind with old/new licence ids.

findings.title: No rate limit on /license/document and /license/deauthorize; deauthorize lacks device header and audit
findings.impact: Cost, availability; eases the stale-upsert race.
findings.fix: Per-token and per-network limiters; require X-PKey-Device; audit deauthorize; cap refusal rows.

findings.title: Store flag names under reserved keys (license.tier, deviceLimit, channels) reach the signed document
findings.exploitability: Needs an operator to map a store flag to a reserved name.
findings.fix: Reject reserved names; strip reserved keys from non-admin layers.

findings.title: Token is a bearer credential with no post-activation device binding (R3-05)
findings.impact: Stolen token works anywhere; known accepted risk.

findings.title: Anti-replay floor lastAcceptedIssuedAt is optional in the verifier
findings.exploitability: Host omitting the floor or deleted cache; non-Node SDKs unchecked.
findings.impact: Replay of older valid document within grace.

findings.title: Offline bundles and cached documents cannot be revoked, last up to 365 days and consume no seat
findings.fix: Record issuance, cap bundles, lower grace ceiling, signed revocation list.

findings.title: Enroll catch-all swallows non-unique-violation errors
findings.impact: D1 outage reported as enroll_failed without diagnostics.

findings.title: 304 response on licence document lacks cache-control: no-store
Admin gate has no per-product role
Retire on a revoked signing key silently un-revokes it
findings.exploitability: One authenticated admin POST to keys/retire.
findings.impact: Revoked key rejoins JWKS and trust manifest; audit says only 'Retired'.
findings.fix: Make revoked terminal (409); conditional UPDATE; never null revoked_at; regression test.

findings.title: Activate vs revoke race: revoked kid becomes active signing key, or no active key remains
findings.exploitability: Admin-only; two near-simultaneous calls. 23/150 revoked-active, 59/150 zero-active on real D1.
findings.impact: Revoked key signs, or all signed surfaces go dark.
findings.fix: Conditional UPDATEs in one atomic batch; 409 on 0 rows; concurrency test.

findings.title: Pin-only clients are blinded on key rotation; a compromised pinned key cannot be revoked remotely
findings.exploitability: Premise: prior key compromise. Old-pin clients cannot verify new manifests.
findings.impact: Compromise response ineffective for lagging clients.
findings.fix: Multi-sign manifests during migration; pinned-kid tombstone; guard activate unless new kid is a shipped pin.

findings.title: Non-canonical base64url: 16 signature spellings and 4 public-key spellings verify
findings.exploitability: Anyone holding one valid JWS can mint 15 variants.
findings.impact: Dedupe/hash-keyed revocation/log correlation evasion; no forgery. Swift/Kotlin/Godot untested.
findings.fix: Decode-re-encode equality in all decoders; add negative vectors to conformance corpus v2.

findings.title: Download-ticket MAC and registry pull-token signature accept 4 spellings
Python b64url_decode accepts a trailing newline (regex $ with re.match)
findings.exploitability: Not exploitable on JWS path; other call sites unaudited.

findings.title: Uncaught DataError from crypto.subtle.importKey escapes verifyChain callers (App Attest, Apple JWS)
findings.exploitability: Unauthenticated on Apple webhook; crafted x5c with invalid EC point.
findings.fix: Wrap importKey/verify; typed refusals; fuzz regression test.

findings.title: Apple JWS chain evaluated at attacker-chosen signedDate, no lower bound
findings.exploitability: Needs a leaked or expired Apple leaf key.
findings.impact: Old-key holder can sign still-verifying notifications.

findings.title: Second keys/prepare in same second throws UNIQUE (500); kid is low-entropy and wraps
Attestation challenge redemption is not atomic (KV get-then-delete)
findings.exploitability: Device holding challenge plus genuine attestation.
findings.impact: Duplicate trust writes and audit rows; extra Google quota.
findings.fix: Consume via SingleUseDO or D1 unique insert.

findings.title: Attestation keyId not bound to a device; sticky attested level; unverified receipt; appIds scoped to Team ID
findings.exploitability: Genuine handset can attest many device ids.
findings.fix: UNIQUE(product,key_id); expiry; bind appIds; verify receipt.

findings.title: Fingerprint drift ratchet: stored fingerprint overwritten on tolerated drift, allowing stepwise migration to different hardware
findings.exploitability: Licence holder re-activates 2-3 times in normal mode.
findings.impact: Hardware binding no longer limits transfers.
findings.fix: Immutable baseline; cumulative drift cap; do not replace components on tolerated drift.

findings.title: Fingerprint matching is vacuous for stored fingerprints with few components
findings.exploitability: Client chooses component count at first bind.
findings.fix: Minimum component count and anchor; cap tolerance.

findings.title: Unknown or differently-cased key status in the trust manifest fails open
findings.exploitability: Needs server bug or key compromise.
findings.impact: Key meant to be removed stays trusted.

findings.title: Revocation propagation window: revoked entries dropped after 2x300 s
findings.impact: Short unseen-revocation window; bundles keep revoked key 30 days.

findings.title: Email sign-in lockout of a victim recipient: strikes extend the lock with no code issued
findings.exploitability: One wrong guess per 5 minutes holds the lock.
findings.impact: Denial of email sign-in for known address.
findings.fix: Do not extend while locked; strike only with live code; bind to flow.

findings.title: KEY_HASH_PEPPER optional with silent unpeppered SHA-256 fallback
findings.exploitability: Needs data dump and missing pepper.
findings.fix: Throw in non-test; deploy check; migration plan.

findings.title: No minimum length or entropy on HMAC secrets; download-ticket kid is unsalted SHA-256 prefix
KEK input parsing is lenient and secret-name namespaces are writable
findings.impact: Ambiguity of key bytes; theoretical namespace clash.

findings.title: Admin OIDC ID-token verification lacks maxTokenAge, clockTolerance and requiredClaims
findings.impact: Stale ID token accepted at console login.

findings.title: Admin session is a stateless HMAC cookie with no server-side revocation
findings.impact: Stolen cookie valid up to 8 h.
findings.fix: Session id with revocation; periodic group re-check.

findings.title: Non-constant-time comparison of raw CSRF tokens
Licence document verifier does not validate schemaVersion

findings.impact: CPU/D1 amplification; stale GitHub JWKS up to 24 h.
findings.fix: Cache manifest; configured origin; cap stale JWKS.

findings.title: Python verify_jws defaults to require_typ=False
Delegation expiry checked against signer-chosen issuedAt; offline bundle replay window
findings.exploitability: Held-past-expiry content key or re-import of older bundle.
findings.fix: Check now; pass floor into inspectBundle.

findings.title: Detection gaps: no logging or audit for crypto failures and key events
findings.impact: Slower detection of forgery, fuzzing, key misuse.
findings.fix: Structured counters and audit rows for crypto events.

findings.title: CI hygiene: GitHub Actions pinned by tag; Dependabot lacks Swift and Gradle
findings.impact: Supply-chain exposure in OIDC publish jobs.
findings.fix: Pin SHAs; add ecosystems; add audit step.

findings.title: Any platform-admin session can mint release:publish/yank CI tokens and repoint the trusted publisher on the system product
findings.exploitability: One admin session; PUT ci-publisher 200, POST ci-tokens 201 for polaris-key with no break-glass or step-up. Chain run to release_packages.
findings.impact: One admin cookie reaches platform SDK supply chain via 90-day static token. Propagation to live feeds unverified.
findings.fix: Refuse on system product (manifest-authoritative) or require break-glass + step-up + short expiry; alert.

findings.title: Retiring a revoked signing key un-revokes it (revoked is not terminal)
Step-up (I-12) is satisfied by any ordinary login in the last 5 minutes

findings.impact: Gate proves only a session younger than 5 minutes exists; stolen fresh cookie clears it.
findings.fix: Record stepUpAt only after a prompt=login flow proven by auth_time/amr.

findings.title: Irreversible and PII routes have no step-up or reason: users data/delete, export, detach, product DELETE, break-glass activate, KEK reseal
findings.exploitability: Any session up to 8 h old; executed with a day-old authAt.
findings.impact: PII export, permanent data erasure, product delete, forced key activation.
findings.fix: Shared table of dangerous routes with isSteppedUp; reason and typed confirm.

findings.title: Admin sessions are stateless: no revocation, logout does not invalidate cookie, /docs and slug-check ignore current group
findings.exploitability: Stolen or offboarded cookie valid 8 h; replay after logout 200.
findings.impact: Combined with step-up gaps, near-full takeover for 8 h.
findings.fix: Server-side session epoch; group re-check on /docs; separate portal secret.

findings.title: Admin OIDC login flow is not bound to the initiating browser (login CSRF only)
findings.exploitability: Takeover refuted; only login CSRF by an existing admin.
findings.impact: Victim logged in as attacker's admin identity.
findings.fix: Binder cookie as in portal I-17.

findings.title: Activity feed limit=-1 is unbounded and fractional limits throw 500
findings.impact: Returns every audit row; 500 on fractional.

findings.title: Admin write paths 500 on bad or colliding input; slug-check reports soft-deleted slug as available
Product secret names are unvalidated and can share an AAD with managed secrets
findings.fix: Strict name regex; reserve managed: prefix.

findings.title: Login/callback rate limit keyed by exact IP (IPv6 /64), single global _admin shard, fail-open admin limiter
Audit rows written after the mutation (not atomic) and have no tamper evidence
findings.fix: auditStatementFor in the same batch; optional hash chain.

findings.title: Detection gaps: no sign-in audit, CI-token use unaudited, break-glass records no reason
findings.impact: Stolen cookie or token not visible.
findings.fix: Audit sign-in and token use; alert classes.

findings.title: Upload tickets not bound to requesting scope; no per-token issuance cap

native-desktop.yml uses actions pinned to mutable tags

findings.title: Card/gate JSON endpoints have no content-type, Origin or Fetch-Metadata check
findings.exploitability: Cross-site text/plain POST sets flow cookie.
findings.impact: Flow planting enabler; 8 MB bodies accepted.
findings.fix: Central JSON/Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site check and body cap.

findings.title: Product OIDC callback and /session/license have no browser binding (R8-03 login CSRF / session fixation)
findings.exploitability: Attacker gives victim a callback URL or cross-site POST; repo's own OPEN test documents it.
findings.impact: Victim's data lands in attacker's licence or account.
findings.fix: Binder cookie for every product/issuer; same-origin JSON on /session/license.

findings.title: Device-code flow: starter confirms its own flow, victim identity attaches to attacker's device (R1-07)
findings.exploitability: Attacker curl-confirms, victim finishes IdP leg; poll returned victim token.
findings.impact: Seat theft and access to victim entitlements.
findings.fix: Mandatory binder on confirmed device flows; bind confirm to loading browser.

findings.title: authorizeDevice/activate rebinds a device row held by another licence (device-id takeover)
findings.impact: Silent eviction of victim browser session.

findings.title: Custom-issuer token POST follows redirects and leaks client_secret; no timeout or size cap
isSafeIssuerUrl gaps (https loopback, NAT64, 6to4) and OIDC_ISSUER_ALLOWLIST fails open
findings.exploitability: Needs operator-set hostile issuer; edge reachability unknown.

findings.title: Recipient-keyed email-code lockout: unauthenticated suppression of a victim's sign-in mail
findings.exploitability: 11 requests per 15 min from one IP.
findings.fix: Key strikes on recipient+flow/network; Turnstile on verify.

findings.title: Provider and portal callbacks consume the single-use flow before the binder check (state burning)
DELETE /api/me, licence removal and registry-token mint require no fresh step-up
Email-less accounts receive no out-of-band notice for link, unlink or merge
accountUsingEmail ignores verified account_links.email, one verified address can count on two accounts
findings.exploitability: Needs IdP asserting same email for second subject.

findings.title: Product browser-session cookie parsing: malformed percent-encoding throws; first-match duplicate; no __Host-
findings.exploitability: Cookie-tossing from sibling host for fixation.
findings.fix: try/catch decode; fail closed on duplicates; __Host-.

findings.title: Browser sessions of one licence share one device (browser:<licenseId>)
findings.impact: Surprise sign-outs; target id for takeover.

findings.title: parseEmail accepts address-list and header metacharacters passed verbatim to mail binding
redirectUriAllowed fails open when redirect_uris_json is NULL (R8-07)
findings.impact: Code delivery to attacker host if IdP accepts.

Two flows share cookie name __Host-pkey_signin with different SameSite
Chosen licence not re-checked for ownership at device-poll mint (TOCTOU)

Detection gaps: no audit for failed ID-token, state, binder, lockout, redirect abuse or device eviction
Blob route serves private package files (all ecosystems) anonymously by sha256; dist_access, feed access_mode, yank and release removal ignored
findings.exploitability: Anonymous, needs only the sha256 (lockfiles, PyPI fragments, OCI digests). Proven for OCI, Maven, PyPI; Cargo/Go/Swift not run.
findings.impact: Paid/licensed package contents disclosed; yank does not close it; 1-year public cache keeps bytes.

findings.title: F-Droid relay publicKeyIsPublic treats package-file 'artifact' refs as public per app mode
findings.exploitability: Relay needs ticket or existing feed ref.

findings.title: Revoking a publish token does not cancel its open native-upload sessions; sweep/settle still publishes
findings.exploitability: Leaked publish credential and an upload started before revoke; lands ~10 s (twine) to ~25 min (Maven) later.
findings.impact: Attacker version published after revoke and number burned.

findings.title: Any live pkeyci_ token of the owner reads every non-public package feed and mints OCI pull tokens; revocation lags up to 30 s
